kurz: Milk brings protein, fat, sugar and water. It browns baked goods, thickens with starch and can catch and curdle.
bild_im_kopf: An all-rounder with a tendency to boil over.
was_passiert: When heated, milk forms a skin of protein, and protein easily catches on the bottom. Acid makes it curdle.
faustregeln: Warm over medium heat and stir.
Rinse the pan with cold water first: milk catches less.
